identity: POI extract_landmarks_961954901 (Wikidata Q1616123). The native 'Scheepvaartmuseum' kit (museumKits.ts, hall r3604837, courtyard w269078550) is superseded by suppressing r3604837, w269078550 and BAG pand 0363100012170236.

sources.use: ref-nw.jpg: NW quay facade (pavilion, ten axes per wing)
ref-se.jpg: SE entrance facade (door, arched windows, cartouche, wings)
ref-ne.jpg: NE facade (pairs of arched windows, door, bridge)
ref-sw.jpg: SW water-gate facade, ship away (HET SCHEEPVAARTMUSEUM lettering not reproduced)

notes: Facade planes (wing and pavilion distances d1/d2/dp) read from the 3DBAG wall surfaces; NW wing pitch and counts from the photograph (10 axes), SE 12 axes, NE/SW 9 axes per wing (SW from the 2017 photograph; NE wings repeat it). The SE photograph shows narrow windows on the pavilion side returns; the other returns are not photographed and carry none. The roof is steep (3DBAG: 17.6 m at the wall, ridge 22.5 m 4 m back); dormers sit on that roof above the arched axes. The pediment apex (22.9 m) is built up from a stone plate because 3DBAG trims the gable peak to 21.9 m.
